title: Machine learning-based modulation of Ca <sup>2+</sup> -binding affinity in EF-hand proteins and comparative structural insights into site-specific cooperative binding
authors: Mohit Mazumder; Sanjeev Kumar; Devbrat Kumar; Alok bhattacharya; S. Gourinath
one_liner_zh: 该文用机器学习评分方案设计EF-hand蛋白突变以调控钙结合亲和力，并解析结构，但对象为蛋白-钙离子互作而非蛋白质-DNA，方法可迁移性有限，仅边缘相关。
abstract: Ca 2+ -binding proteins are present in almost all living organisms and different types display different levels of binding affinities for the cation. Here, we applied two new scoring schemes enabling the user to manipulate the binding affinities of such proteins. We specifically designed a unique EF-hand loop capable of binding calcium with high affinity by altering five residues of the loop based on the scoring scheme. We worked on the N-terminal domain of Entamoeba histolytica calcium-binding protein1 (Nt Eh CaBP1), and used site-directed mutagenesis to incorporate the designed loop sequence into the second EF hand motif of this protein. The binding isotherms calculated using ITC calorimetry showed a ∼500-fold greater association constant (K a ) for the mutant. The crystal structure of the mutant was also determined, and displayed more compact Ca 2+ -coordination spheres in both of its EF loops than did the structure of the wildtype protein, consistent with the greater calcium-binding affinities of the mutant. The Nt Eh CaBP1 mutant was also shown to form a hexamer rather than just a trimer, and this hexamer formation was attributed to the position of the last helix of the mutant having been changed as a result of the strong calcium coordination. Further dynamic correlation analysis revealed that the mutation in the second EF loop changed the entire residue network of the monomer, resulting in a stronger coordination of Ca 2+ even in other EF hand loop.
abstract_zh: Ca 2+ 结合蛋白几乎存在于所有生物体中，不同类型的蛋白对该阳离子表现出不同水平的结合亲和力。在此，我们应用了两种新的评分方案，使用户能够操控此类蛋白的结合亲和力。我们基于评分方案，通过改变环的五个残基，特别设计了一个能够高亲和力结合钙离子的独特EF-hand环。我们以溶组织内阿米巴钙结合蛋白1的N端结构域（Nt Eh CaBP1）为研究对象，并利用定点突变技术将设计的环序列引入该蛋白的第二个EF-hand基序中。通过ITC量热法计算的结合等温线显示，突变体的结合常数（K a ）比野生型高约500倍。我们还确定了突变体的晶体结构，其两个EF环中的Ca 2+ 配位球比野生型蛋白的结构更为紧凑，这与突变体更高的钙结合亲和力一致。Nt Eh CaBP1突变体还被证明形成六聚体而非仅三聚体，这种六聚体的形成归因于突变体最后一个螺旋的位置因强钙配位而发生变化。进一步的动态相关性分析揭示，第二个EF环中的突变改变了单体的整个残基网络，导致即使在另一个EF-hand环中也实现了更强的Ca 2+ 配位。
